jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

Candidates for this role should have Electronic Security Services Experience!
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

As a Senior Project Manager in Electronic Security Systems (ESS), you oversee all aspects of project execution—including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client satisfaction—across the entire project lifecycle, from initiation to closure. You are accountable for the successful delivery of large\-scale, complex ESS projects, requiring effective delegation, diligent follow\-through, and assurance of key deliverables. Your role centers on harnessing subject matter expertise, driving decision\-making, and aligning cross\-functional teams, all while maintaining clear and impactful communication with stakeholders and executive leadership.
  
  

The Sr PM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions with respect to cost, quality and schedule. The Sr PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project management activities. This position provides oversight and direction to a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

As a primary interface to the client, the Sr. Project Manager develops a strong long\-term relationship \- managing the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

**Daily activities include:**  

Leads the delivery of physical security systems by managing implementation, coordinating teams, and ensuring compliance with specifications, timelines, and quality standards.
  
  

Demonstrates expertise in the delivery and integration of physical security technologies, including closed\-circuit television (CCTV) systems, electronic access control systems, intrusion detection alarms, and perimeter security solutions.
  
  

Must possess a strong understanding of general construction sequencing and its impact on project scheduling, risk mitigation, and potential delays. Responsible for identifying, qualifying, and quantifying construction\-related risks, and communicating those risks clearly and effectively to the stakeholders in written form to support proactive planning and resolution.
  
  

Collaborates in design reviews to support accurate and comprehensive field documentation across project teams.
  
  

Demonstrated proficiency in developing schedules, establishing project baselines, and identifying, qualifying, and quantifying deviations, with clear communication of impacts to the client.
  
  

Responsible for coordinating field verification of prospective work sites, ensuring compliance with quality control requirements, confirming readiness, and documenting site conditions.
  
  

Demonstrates a strong ability to monitor and control the financial health of projects, including tracking budgets, costs, and margins. Proactively identifies financial risks and implements corrective actions to prevent margin erosion, ensuring profitability and alignment with financial targets.
  
  

Proactively identifies potential customer concerns and addresses them before they escalate into issues. Delivers thoughtful, comprehensive solutions to both clients and internal stakeholders, fostering trust and ensuring a smooth project experience.
  
  

Provides flexible, on\-demand support to team members, proactively assisting with tasks, problem\-solving, and resource coordination to help ensure project success and team efficiency. Demonstrates a collaborative mindset and a willingness to step in wherever needed to keep work progressing and goals on track.
  
  

Partners with the site supervisor to establish and drive the project’s work plan and schedule, ensuring alignment with overall project goals and timelines.
  
  

Coordinates stakeholder activities to enable system programming and final checkout of systems.
  
Requires proven experience in coordinating all critical activities involved in the successful commissioning of security systems, including planning, execution, testing, and documentation. The candidate must ensure systems are fully operational, meet design specifications, and are ready for client handover.
  
  

Works closely with the site supervisor, general contractor, and end user to develop and manage a comprehensive punch list of outstanding tasks following substantial completion. Ensures timely resolution of remaining items to support project closeout and client satisfaction.
  
  

Facilitates project turnover and training sessions with clients, and service team.

jobs.title: Affiliate Marketing Project Manager / Executive Admin
jobs.description:
About Clutch Affiliate

Clutch Affiliate is a women\-owned affiliate and partnership marketing agency working with CPG and DTC brands across Amazon, DTC/network affiliate, publisher affiliate, TikTok Shop, and PR affiliate. With remote offices in Tampa, Florida and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, we run lean and move fast, both with our clients and with each other. If you like clear ownership over your work and don't want corporate red tape, you'll fit in here.

The Role

We're looking for a Project Manager / Admin who can be the connective tissue across Clutch. This role oversees the moving pieces across our full client roster and supports our co\-founders directly, keeping projects, deadlines, and next steps on track internally and with clients. You'll need to be organized, proactive, and comfortable owning the details other people forget to track.

This is not primarily an affiliate marketing execution role. Affiliate marketing knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement, we're happy to train that piece. What matters most is that you're a sharp project manager and administrator who can keep multiple clients and workstreams moving without being told twice.

We're not currently tied to a specific project management platform. If you have strong experience with a PM tool you love (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Notion, or otherwise) and think it would serve us well, we're genuinely open to adopting it.

If it's a mutual fit, there's real room to grow into full\-time as our client base expands.

What You'll Do

\- Serve as the central point of organization across all client accounts, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and next steps

\- Provide direct administrative support to Clutch's co\-founders, managing schedules, priorities, and follow\-through

\- Keep internal projects on track, flagging what's falling behind before it becomes a problem

\- Coordinate across the team to make sure client needs are being met on time

\- Build and maintain systems (trackers, checklists, calendars) that keep the agency organized as it scales

\- Sit in on client calls as needed to capture next steps and keep projects moving

\- Support affiliate program operations where needed (we'll train you on this as it comes up)

\- Bring ideas to the table on how to make Clutch run more efficiently, not just execute on someone else's

What You Need

\- Strong project management skills, comfortable juggling multiple clients and priorities at once

\- Excellent organizational skills and follow\-through, nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

\- Comfortable providing high\-level administrative support to founders

\- Self\-starter energy. We're not going to micromanage you; we need someone who sees what needs doing and does it

\- Clear, confident communicator, both internally and with clients

\- Genuine interest in helping a small agency run well and grow

Nice to Have

\- Familiarity with affiliate/publisher marketing (CJ, Avantlink, AWIN, or Impact)

\- PR affiliate experience

\- Experience with a PM platform you'd advocate for us adopting

Hours and Structure

Flexible and remote. Potential to expand to full\-time based on performance and agency growth.

Pay

Hourly, based on experience.

To Apply

To help us see who reads instructions carefully, please include the following when you apply:

1\. In your cover letter or application message, name one podcast episode Clutch Affiliate has appeared on (you'll find this on our website at www.clutchaffiliate.com).

2\. Include the phrase "Growth Partner" somewhere in your subject line or application message.

Applications that skip these steps will not be considered.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

 **About this Position**


The Sage X3 Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Sage Intacct implementations for Net at Work clients. This role centers around client excellence, building trusted partnerships, maintaining high satisfaction levels, and driving long\-term value.

  

The PM works directly with clients to clarify business requirements, propose scalable solutions, and ensure smooth implementation. They serve as the key liaison between clients and internal teams, leveraging strong communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills. The PM also supports the sales team by contributing to project scoping and helping to expand client relationships through ongoing service opportunities.

**Client Relationship Management \& Client Excellence*** Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for clients throughout the project lifecycle.

* Proactively manage client communications, providing strategic updates and anticipating needs to drive a positive experience.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to align project execution with client goals, ensuring outcomes meet or exceed expectations.
* Ensure a smooth transition to post\-implementation support, maintaining continuity and client confidence.
* Identify and surface opportunities for additional services or solutions that support client success and contribute to account growth.

 **Project Planning \& Initiation*** Develop comprehensive project plans outlining timelines, milestones, budgets, deliverables, and resource requirements.
* Lead team onboarding activities to ensure alignment and readiness for successful project execution.

* Oversee project financials, including revenue recognition and budget tracking.
* Facilitate the discovery, scoping, development, and delivery of change requests.
* Monitor project progress and proactively adjust plans to meet client expectations.
* Track key milestones and timelines, reallocating resources and adjusting workflows as needed.
* Manage third\-party project deliverables and follow up to ensure timely closure.

 **Client \& Stakeholder Communication*** Serve as the primary liaison for all internal and external project stakeholders, ensuring clear and consistent communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead regular project status meetings, tailoring cadence and format to project size and complexity.
* Distribute weekly status summaries, meeting recaps, and recordings, and maintain organized documentation within the designated project folder.
* Keep project plans, timelines, and budgets up to date, proactively communicating changes and impacts to stakeholders.
* Provide timely and strategic updates to clients and executive leadership to ensure alignment and transparency.

 **Issue Management \& Risk Mitigation*** Identify, assess, and address issues that may impact project scope, timeline, or deliverables.

* Lead issue resolution efforts, collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders to keep projects on track.
* Proactively escalate risks and implement mitigation strategies to minimize disruption and ensure successful outcomes.

 **Project Closure \& Transition*** Ensure all project deliverables are completed to defined quality standards and client expectations.
* Lead project closure meetings and coordinate seamless transitions to post\-implementation support teams.
* Document lessons learned and contribute insights to continuous improvement initiatives and best practices.

 **Process Improvement \& Strategic Input*** Provide strategic recommendations to enhance administrative and operational processes that support project delivery and client success.
* Contribute to process analysis, redesign initiatives, and organizational effectiveness efforts to drive continuous improvement and scalability.

* Minimum of 4 years of progressive experience leading ERP implementation projects for Sage X3 or similar ERP solutions (SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Infor, Syspro, ProccessPRO, MS Dynamics)

* Solid understanding of ERP concepts; experience in process manufacturing or distribution manufacturing desired.
* Proven track record of achieving business objectives and meeting key performance metrics.
* Bachelor’s degree required.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross\-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.


Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management's strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

**Responsibilities**


Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

* **Project \& Timeline Management:** Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.
* **Product \& Cross‑Functional Leadership:** Partner closely with Product Managers, Marketing, R\&D, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and Creative at both working and leadership levels. Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
* **Advanced Risk Management:** Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
* Typically 7–10\+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

**Management Skills**

* **Detail‑Oriented:** Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
* **Communication:** Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
* **Problem‑Solving:** Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
* **Cross‑Functional Fluency:** Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
* **Adaptability \& Ambiguity:** Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Mediator, not Participant:** Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.
* **Conflict Navigation:** Navigates complex, high‑stakes conflicts across teams and leadership levels with sound judgment. Resolves competing priorities constructively, escalating appropriately to protect project outcomes.
* **Calm in the Storm:** Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.
* **Attention to Detail:** Continuously monitors program health at both project and portfolio levels, ensuring small gaps or inconsistencies are identified early and do not scale into larger delivery or quality issues.

US$130,000\.00 \- US$140,000\.00 Annually

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people\-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Analyst
jobs.description:
The Senior Information Security Analyst strengthens enterprise cyber risk management by improving risk visibility, reducing exposure, validating security control effectiveness, and producing clear business\-focused reporting for technical, audit, compliance, and executive stakeholders. The role supports a maturing Information Security program across vulnerability management, security controls, cloud operations, data protection, governance, risk, compliance, and cyber defense.

**Primary Responsibilities**

This position is responsible for measurable remediation of vulnerabilities and security findings, effective governance of cloud, application, identity, and data protection controls, audit\-ready evidence and risk documentation, and concise reporting that enables timely leadership decisions. The successful candidate will use enterprise security and risk management platforms to assess security posture, validate remediation, review security incidents, evaluate control effectiveness, support audit and regulatory requirements, and provide meaningful risk intelligence.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Vulnerability and Findings Management:** Lead analysis, prioritization, tracking, and reporting of vulnerability, application security, cloud security, endpoint, and infrastructure findings to drive timely remediation and risk reduction.
* **Risk Governance:** Support risk acceptance, exception, deferment, and compensating control processes by ensuring decisions are documented, justified, time\-bound, and aligned to organizational risk appetite.
* **Security Control Review:** Evaluate security controls across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Defender , Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS, Azure, ServiceNow (), Qualys, SonarQube, and related enterprise platforms.
* **Architecture and Advisory Support:** Participate in security architecture, threat modeling, DevSecOps, identity and access management, privileged access, data protection, and third\-party risk reviews to identify control gaps and recommend practical mitigation actions.
* **Audit and Compliance Support:** Support internal audits, client audits, regulatory reviews, and due diligence activities through evidence collection, remediation tracking, risk analysis, and clear status reporting.
* **Metrics and Reporting:** Develop dashboards, metrics, executive summaries, and recurring reports that communicate security posture, remediation progress, compliance performance, control effectiveness, and emerging risk trends.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

This role will work with enterprise security and risk management platforms including Qualys, Microsoft Defender , Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra ID, ServiceNow (), SonarQube, Power Automate, Power BI, majorly Azure, AWS to a lesser extent and related security and compliance technologies.

**Experience and Education**

* **Education and Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, with 7\-12 years of progressive information security experience across vulnerability management, security operations, cloud security, risk management, governance, compliance, audit support, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Proven experience with vulnerability management, DLP, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID, Qualys, Splunk, ServiceNow, Power BI, or comparable security and risk management platforms.
* **Security and Risk Expertise:** Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 security services, cloud security concepts, identity controls, application security findings, regulatory obligations, and industry frameworks such as CIS Controls and SOC 2 standard.
* **Communication and Execution:** Excellent analytical, written, verbal, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

**Certifications:** Relevant certifications such as CCSP, CISSP, SSCP, GCED, or similar are preferred.

**Performance Expectations**

Success in this role will be measured by improved risk visibility, stronger remediation performance, audit readiness, effective security control governance, increased cloud and DevSecOps maturity, and measurable reductions in enterprise cybersecurity risk.

: Timely and effective vulnerability remediation, Reduction of vulnerability aging and backlog, Positive trending in overall vulnerability reduction, Monitoring and reduction of exposure to vulnerabilities listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog, Consistent tracking and reporting of relevant vulnerability exposure metrics.

*Reassignment Applicants*: Eligible Reassignment clients should contact their Disability Counselor for assistance.

**DESCRIPTION**
===============

**DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW:**


The Mission of the San Diego Supercomputer Center is to translate innovation into practice. SDSC adopts and partners on innovations in industry and academia in the areas of software, hardware, computational and data sciences, and related areas, and translates them into cyberinfrastructure that solves practical problems across any and all scientific domains and societal endeavors. Cyberinfrastructure refers to an accessible, integrated network of high\-performance computing, data, and networking resources and expertise, focused on accelerating scientific inquiry and discovery. With more than 250 employees and $30\-50M of revenue a year, SDSC is a global leader in the design, development, and operations of cyberinfrastructure.


SDSC supports hundreds of multidisciplinary programs spanning a wide variety of domains, from earth sciences and biology to astrophysics, bioinformatics, and health IT. SDSC presently operates multiple large HPC systems ranging from a 120k x86 CPU core general purpose system to a system explicitly designed for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, and a nationally distributed system open for all of academia to integrate with. SDSC offers research data services across the entire vertical stack from universally scalable storage to consulting services on FAIR, Big Data, and AI. SDSC offers a rich set of cloud services both on\-premise, in the commercial cloud, and as hybrid services across both.


SDSC has three geographic scopes, a national scope supporting cyberinfrastructure for the entire US research and education community, a California scope with a special focus on convergence research that addresses the three dominant threats to CA: Drought, Fire, Earthquakes, and a campus scope focusing on advancing the global impact of SDSC by advancing the research objectives of the UC San Diego faculty, researchers, and students.


SDSC impacts researchers at scales from 1,000’s to Millions. SDSC annually trains thousands of researchers in cyberinfrastructure tools and software, and supports thousands of individual researchers via Unix accounts on its large HPC systems. SDSC was a leader developing the Science Gateway concept, and continues to be a global leader in its evolution. SDSC operates multiple major such gateways with user communities ranging from the tens of thousands to the millions. SDSC’s educational programs include online courses that have been attended by more than a million students.


SDSC is committed to democratizing access to cyberinfrastructure across all of its geographic scopes. SDSC strives towards a culture that supports our employees to be their best, achieve their goals, and enjoy their lives, both professionally and personally.


Prof. Tim Mackey operates a public health data science lab situated at SDSC. This lab is interdisciplinary and is funded by state and Federal grants, exploring topics including Infodemiology, data science and health topics, and health policy.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
======================

**This is a 50% part\-time Career position.**


The Research Data Analyst works on research data reporting assignments that are of moderate diversity in scope and exercises judgment within generally defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions.


The Research Data Analyst will provide technical, research, and analytical skills along with applied programming, data modeling and data management in support of federally funded and extramural grant projects. Specifically, the position will require statistical, computational, and data analysis work on internal and external research grants that involve analysis of both structured and unstructured data. The incumbent applies data, programming, systems engineering, and information management concepts to conducting scientific research for healthcare, public health, and data science projects, works on data of moderate scope and complexity where analyses of situations or data require a review of a variety of factors and participates in the creation and implementation of applied mathematical models analyzing structured and unstructured data, building data collection and management applications, translating findings to research results, and developing manuscripts and abstracts for scientific presentation. Additionally, the Research Data Analyst designs and implements capture of metadata from technical processes such as machine learning, deep learning, topic models, natural language processing, and database management, extracts data from multiple data sources and integrates with other secondary data layers and other sources as well as analyzes and models data with the aim to provides actionable insights to collaborating teams to aid processes within the institution and will also work on visualization projects to create institutional and research\-based dashboard development.


For more information, please visit: https://www.sdsc.edu/

Built by enterprise software engineers and compliance experts, we provide comprehensive ACA reporting and compliance services. jobs.title: Construction Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Joining American Builders** is a commercial general contractor at One World Trade Center. We build interior fit\-outs across Manhattan and the boroughs, and we run facade and exterior restoration work alongside it. Most of our jobs are in occupied buildings on tight cycles. We are hiring an Assistant Project Manager for the field.

**What you will do**

You are the person who makes sure every job has a complete paper record. You move between our active job sites, you fill out the field documentation on each one, you keep the binders current and organized, and you scan every document the same day and file it into Dropbox under the right project, the right category, and the right name.

* Daily sign\-in sheets, daily reports, daily checklists, pre\-shift meeting records, DOB checklists, and the safety binders. Complete, legible, and done the day they are due.
* Scan every document the day it is generated. Name it to our convention and file it correctly. Keep the physical copies current on site.
* Move between two or more active sites in different boroughs in the same day without dropping documentation on any of them.
* Collect and log subcontractor certificates of insurance and permits. Follow up in advance of expiration, not after.
* Scan and file signed company paperwork as it is executed: subcontractor agreements, W\-9s, and new hire documents.
* Daily progress photos, filed with the rest of the record.

The documentation work is the first ninety days and it is the foundation. From there, and at the pace you earn it, this seat opens into project controls: submittal logs, change order tracking, procurement follow\-up, and requisition support. We have promoted from exactly this starting point before and we would rather train someone into the next seat than hire into it. We are saying this in the posting because we want someone who is genuinely interested in construction. If daily documentation sounds beneath you, this is the wrong job.

**What you need**

* A working smartphone you can scan, photograph, label and upload from every day. You will demonstrate this in the interview on your own device.
* Comfort with a scanning app, Dropbox and email as daily working tools.
* Clear written English. Your file names, reports and notes are read by the client, by ownership, and potentially by an inspector.
* A current SST card, or willingness to complete the 40 hour SST course. If you do not have a card, we pay for the course.
* Reliable transportation between job sites across the boroughs.
* Legal authorization to work in the United States.
* Genuine interest in construction. This is the requirement we care about most.

**Nice to have**

* Any time on a commercial construction site, in any trade or field support role.
* A construction management or construction technology program, in progress or completed.
* A 40 hour or 62 hour SST card already in hand, or OSHA 10 or OSHA 30\.
* Experience keeping a job site documented for an inspection or an audit.
* Working Spanish. A good portion of the trades on our sites are Spanish speaking.
* Exposure to Procore or a comparable project platform. We will teach it.

**Pay and terms**

* $17\.00 to $25\.00 per hour, depending on experience and certification.
* Full time, hourly, W\-2\. Non\-exempt. Overtime paid at time and a half over 40 hours in a week, scheduled and approved in advance.
* Travel between job sites during the workday is paid time. Travel costs reimbursed on receipts or logged mileage.
* JAB pays for the 40 hour SST course if you do not hold a card.
* Six month review of rate and responsibilities. Merit increases are reviewed each January 1, one per calendar year. An increase required by a change in the statutory minimum wage takes effect on its own date and is separate from a merit increase.
* Health and dental are not offered with this position today. We are evaluating options for 2027\.

This is an in person role on New York City job sites. It is not remote and it is not hybrid.

The hourly range above is the good\-faith range for this position as required under NYC Local Law 32\. Joining American Builders Inc. d/b/a JAB Enterprises is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants based on job\-related qualifications and experience.

Pay: $17\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 – 60\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a smartphone you can use every day to scan documents, take photos, and upload files to Dropbox?
* Are you able to work on job sites in New York City every day, and travel between boroughs on the same day? This role is fully in person.
* Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
* Do you currently hold an SST card? If yes, is it the 40 hour or the 62 hour card?
* In two or three sentences, why do you want to work in construction?
* How many years have you worked on a commercial construction site, in any role?

Language:

* English (Required)
* Spanish (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Manhattan, NY 10007 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Finance
jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**


adMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines.  

  

Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next\-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking.  

  

Our award\-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike.

##### **The Role**


We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Finance team, dedicated to marketplace operations. The right person is passionate about connecting the dots between financial performance, day\-to\-day operational execution, and the underlying supply/demand dynamics that drive our marketplace. You'll sit inside Finance but work hands\-on with Operations (Demand Ops, Supply Ops, Campaign Management) and Pricing \& Yield, turning disparate operational and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations.


This role gives you a dedicated seat inside marketplace operations while reporting through Finance — visibility across the business that few analyst roles offer.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the dedicated data analyst embedded in marketplace operations, working day\-to\-day with Demand Ops, Supply Ops, and Campaign Management while reporting through FP\&A.
* Analyze marketplace dynamics — supply/demand balance, pricing trends, yield, and competitive positioning — to surface insights that inform operational and revenue decisions.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and build reporting that improves day\-to\-day decision\-making across the teams you support.
* Build and maintain models and dashboards that unify financial and operational data, reducing manual reporting effort over time.
* Translate complex, cross\-functional analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership, including financial impact, tradeoffs, and risk.
* Support scenario planning and variance analysis tying operational drivers to financial outcomes.
* Identify emerging trends across the marketplace and proactively flag risks or opportunities before they materially affect performance.
* Establish and document best practices for analytical rigor and reporting consistency between Finance and Operations.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, BI, CS, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related analytical role.
* Demonstrated experience independently owning analytical projects and translating findings into measurable business outcomes.
* Proven ability to organize and analyze large datasets, identify trends, and translate complex analyses into clear business recommendations.
* Experience developing forecasting or analytical models and evaluating their performance over time.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, lookups, etc.).
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
* Experience building dashboards using Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar BI platforms.
* Experience with Python or other scripting languages is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical thinking, business judgment, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.
* Experience in digital advertising, marketplace businesses, e\-commerce, fintech, or related industries is preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Compensation:** $80,000 – $90,000 \+ Bonus \& Equity

**Join Us**


adMarketplace has been named as one of the best places to work in New York City by Built In and Crain’s\- the latter of which have recognized us the past three years straight! AMP is currently experiencing triple digit growth, and it’s never been a better time to join our team!


We offer a robust continuing education program, management training, regular company\-wide lunch and learns, and well\-defined career paths to ensure all our employees have an opportunity to grow.


At adMarketplace, we play to win, but we learn from our setbacks. Our commitment to a collaborative environment means no one succeeds alone, and no one fails alone either.


We know you’ve come to expect comprehensive healthcare, wellness programs, paid time off, commuter benefits, and 401k matching from any company, so it’s a good thing we offer all of that and so much more. adMarketplace offers Summer Fridays, catered lunches, a fully stocked kitchen, ZogSports teams, happy hours and corporate retreats to encourage a strong work/life balance.


No Third Party Recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lead the Air Force’s cloud program as our designated Program Manager, a key personnel role under the contract’s Performance Work Statement. * Experience managing government reporting and deliverables, including Monthly Status Reports, In\-Process Reviews, and CDRLs, and SLAs on a cloud or IT operations and maintenance contract

jobs.description:
**This Opportunity**
--------------------

The Power Delivery Project Manager (PDPM) will manage Distribution resiliency projects throughout Louisiana, with the ability to work remotely or hybrid from any mutually acceptable location in the region. This role will be performed as part of a larger program team. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings. Tasks include providing technical project supervision and guidance in managing the administrative, commercial, and technical components of electric utility, power distribution, and power delivery infrastructure projects in alignment with WSP’s core values and contractual commitments. The PDPM will be responsible for overall performance of distribution resiliency work. Oversight includes financial performance, technical execution, client satisfaction, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC), safety, and schedule adherence.  



  

Ensures that responsibilities throughout the full project lifecycle (feasibility, engineering design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout) are executed in compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, NEC), and utility industry best practices.


As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world\-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure\-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.


**Your Impact**
---------------

* Lead and oversee cross\-functional teams delivering power distribution, substation, and utility engineering projects, ensuring execution of design and construction deliverables.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects involving distribution lines, feeders, substations, and grid infrastructure upgrades, including budgets, schedule, cost control, and resource allocation.
* Develop and manage project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and resource plans for utility capital improvement programs and transmission \& distribution (T\&D) projects.
* Build and maintain Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) aligned with engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models.
* Ensure compliance with utility standards, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and safety protocols (OSHA, utility HSE standards).
* Participate in proposal development, RFP responses, and business development efforts within the power \& energy market.
* Perform margin analysis, risk assessments, and contingency planning for large\-scale power delivery projects.
* Coordinate contract negotiations, client presentations, and stakeholder meetings with utilities, municipalities, and regulatory agencies.
* Develop and maintain project plans including PMP, Safety Plans, Risk Management Plans, and QA/QC procedures.
* Collaborate with engineering teams specializing in distribution design, protection \& controls, relay systems, and grid automation.
* Partner with Project Accounting to manage financials including forecasting, earned value management (EVM), and profitability tracking.
* Lead efforts in change management, scope control, and claims mitigation.
* Coordinate with technical managers on staffing for overhead and underground distribution projects, substations, and renewable interconnections.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, escalating issues when necessary.
* Provide reporting to clients and leadership on project performance, risks, schedule, and budget status.
* Manage project closeout activities, including lessons learned and continuous improvement for future T\&D projects.
* Stay current on power industry trends, grid resilience, distributed energy resources (DER), and electrification initiatives.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision\-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related field.
* 10\+ years of relevant post education experience. Preferred in a project management role within the Power Delivery/Utility Industry or design experience with Overhead Distribution, Transmission, or Substation assets.
* Strong understanding of utility operations, power systems engineering, and electrical distribution design.
* Familiarity with NERC, IEEE standards, NEC codes, and utility regulatory requirements.
* Experience with EPC project delivery, capital programs, and infrastructure projects within the energy sector.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills in complex utility environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills working with utilities, clients, regulators, and internal engineering teams.
* Experience with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera P6\), financial tracking, and reporting systems.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams including engineering, design, procurement, and construction professionals.
Knowledge of QA/QC processes, risk management, and safety compliance in utility projects.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* PMI Certification (PMP).

Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**


The Assistant Commissioning Manager supports the planning, execution, and oversight of testing and commissioning activities for SOLV Energy’s High‑Voltage (HV), Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and Photovoltaic (PV) projects. In this role, you will work closely with the Commissioning Manager and technical subject‑matter experts to ensure all systems and components are installed, tested, and commissioned in accordance with project requirements, safety standards, and industry best practices. The Assistant Commissioning Manager helps manage project‑level commissioning teams and coordinates with cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure a seamless transition from commissioning through project closeout. This position plays a key role in delivering high‑quality, reliable, and fully operable renewable energy assets.
  

  

This role is hybrid, with onsite presence required at job sites and partial remote work. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Manage the project commissioning team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure efficient and effective execution of tasks.
* Report daily to the Commissioning Manager, the status of each project assigned.

Precision Collective delivers innovative professional services and strategic consulting solutions to federal agencies helping accomplish complex missions with precision, purpose, and exceptional client service. We provide program management, strategic communications, technical consulting, and administrative support services delivering meaningful results. Explore opportunities to join our team at https://precisioncollective.com/careers/

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced leaders, contribute to meaningful federal missions, and grow your career in an environment that values innovation, accountability, and continuous development.  

  

**Position Description**  

Precision Collective is seeking a Senior Proposal \& Business Ops Manager to join our leadership team and play a critical role in the continued growth of the company. This is not a traditional proposal\-management position. The successful candidate will become a trusted partner to the Executive Director of Ops with meaningful ownership across three critical areas of the business: Proposal Leadership \& Business Development, Corporate Operations, and Personnel \& Workforce Management. A qualified candidate will perform the following duties and responsibilities, but are not limited to:


* Lead federal proposals from solicitation release through final submission, including analysis of RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, PWSs, SOWs, and evaluation criteria.

* Bachelor’s degree and relevant professional experience; equivalent military or professional experience may be considered.

**Davis Defense Group, Inc.** has secured a stellar reputation as one of the premier Women\-Owned Small Business (WOSB) in the aerospace and defense industry, steadfastly supporting the Department of Defense since 2002\. A critical combination of vision and dedication to excellence has helped our customers achieve numerous significant milestones on schedule and within budget. Today we employ over 700 personnel around the globe in a mix of analytical, advisory, technical, and support positions. The common thread across our organization is our commitment to our customers and an unwavering dedication to our principle motto: “Mission Focused, Future Ready. Innovating today, Leading tomorrow.”


**Functional Description:**

* Applies analytic techniques in the evaluation of program/project objectives.
* Analyzes requirements, status, budget and schedules.
* Performs management, technical, or business case analyses.
* Collects, completes, organizes and interprets data relating to aircraft/weapon/project acquisition and product programs.
* Tracks program/project status and schedules.
* Applies government\-instituted processes for documentation, change control management and data management.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**


As a Sr. Program Analyst, you are responsible for providing senior staff recommendations for E\-6B related initiatives. Responsibilities include providing sustainment, acquisition, and financial expertise for the E\-6B Mercury strategic airborne command post aircraft supporting the MSA IPTL. Tasking includes creating, managing, and reporting procurement, financial, and contractual performance of assigned E\-6B Mission Systems Architecture and related projects. The position would be responsible directly to IPTs within MSA in tracking of readiness and sustainment requirements for current fleet need/demand as well as tracking and developing future requirements that impact mission systems. Apply knowledge and expertise in continuous process improvement environment to track performance to plan aligned with program office efforts.


* Provide sustainment, acquisition, and financial support for initiatives in support of the E\-6B Mission Systems Architecture IPT.
* Facilitate and manage spend plans using CSPT, PID planning, align SPID entries with the IPT strategy and contract execution, and respond to and develop program data calls.
* Support input and update to the RMT.
* Track and analyze budget planning, execution data, and schedule execution data to provide actionable inputs and recommendations to the Integrated Product Team Lead (IPTL).
* Liaise directly with program office Contract Specialists and Procurement Contracting Officer in the development and processing of SOW, SOO, Performance Work Statements (PWS), Performance Based Specifications, CDRLs, Technical Evaluations, and other contractual documentation for contracting efforts.
* Manage procurements using PMT, including development and management of PID; coordination and preparation of all actions required for conducting Procurement Planning Conferences (PPC’s); generation, routing, and tracking of Procurement Planning Agreements (PPAs); and input, tracking, and reporting of PMT actions and milestones.
* Enter and maintain IPT cost, schedule and performance data in AcqMat; analyze and interpret APHM dashboard data.
* Apply NAVAIR and OSD instructions for acquisition planning, procurement execution, data requirements, program reviews, budget development and coordination, and program planning.
* Participate in status briefs and recommend responses to program inquiries.
* Serves as Program Analyst lead for managing, tracking and reporting procurement status and activities.
* Support the operation of the IPT including scheduling and organizing meetings, making data calls and assessing the data, updating schedules, and supporting development of procurement packages.
* Track program/project status and schedules.
* Develop and coordinate program documentation, requirements documents, and program and budget/funding resource plans.
* Support acquisition strategy development, prepare for program reviews, and review and recommend alternative strategies to reduce program risk.

**Required Experience**:


Minimum of 10 years of combined experience performing duties described in the functional description with at least 3 of those years analyzing budgets.

**Desired Experience**:


* At least 3 years of experience developing and coordinating procurement documentation. Experience with acquisition reviews and cost analysis.
* Experience with the following: Common Spend Plan Tool (CSPT), Program Management Tool (PMT), Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLS), Program, Planning and Budgeting System (PPBS), Statements of Work (SOW), Procurement Initiation Documents (PID), and AcqMat/APHM.
* Knowledge of aircraft mission systems and the modification of those systems for in\-service aircraft.
* Experience working with OEMs, preparing J\&As and developing and editing SOO/SOWs.
* An understanding of the risk management process and the ability to assist with the preparation or review of CDRLs.
* Familiarity with the engineering change process is a plus.
* Proficiency in MS tools, PowerPoint, Excel, TEAMS, and MS Project.
* Ability to create pivot tables and graphs of data from exports of CSPT and other sources.

**Education Requirements****:**


MA/MS degree or supplemental experience is required.


When we review candidates' information, we are looking for the best matches for the position based on the qualifications listed in the job posting.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

*This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA*

The Senior Strategic Program Manager plays a pivotal role in enabling Hilton's Marketing \& Loyalty organization to operationalize high priority strategies into coordinated, measurable business outcomes. This role leads complex strategic programs that may include new launches, enterprise partnerships, Hilton Honors experiences, global marketing initiatives, and other business\-critical priorities.


Reporting to the Director, Global Marketing Strategy, Operations \& Program Management, this role operates with broad influence, partnering closely with executive sponsors and leaders across Hilton's Marketing \& Loyalty organization and the broader enterprise. In a highly matrixed global environment spanning functional teams, business units, trading brands, regions, and external partners, this role serves as a senior integrator from program definition through launch, stabilization, and transition. The Senior Strategic Program Manager brings structure to ambiguity, aligns stakeholders around shared outcomes and decisions, and establishes the governance and execution discipline required to deliver with speed, quality, and accountability.


**What you'll do during a typical day:**

* Lead the end\-to\-end orchestration of complex, high\-priority programs across Marketing \& Loyalty and the broader enterprise, including new brand launches, strategic partnerships, Hilton Honors experiences, cross\-regional initiatives, and other enterprise priorities.
* Translate business strategy and leadership direction into clear program charters, objectives, scope, success measures, integrated roadmaps, and executable workplans.
* Act as a senior integrator across brand, marketing, loyalty, partnerships, regional marketing, commercial, digital, creative, media, analytics, technology, finance and external partners.
* Establish effective program governance, including roles and responsibilities, decision rights, workstream accountabilities, milestone plans, operating cadences, and escalation paths.
* Manage critical paths, cross\-workstream dependencies, resources, risks, issues, changes, and trade\-offs; surface implications early and drive resolution.
* Lead cross\-functional working sessions, leadership reviews, steering committees, and launch\-readiness forums that convert discussion into clear decisions, owners, and actions.
* Balance enterprise objectives and standards with brand, regional, market, and partner needs, ensuring coordinated sequencing, localization, adoption, and execution readiness.
* Identify systemic gaps in ways of working and lead improvements to program management processes, operating models, playbooks, tools, and collaboration practices.

**How you'll collaborate with others:**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive sponsors and senior leaders, providing concise, decision\-oriented communication on program health, risks, trade\-offs, options, and recommendations.
* Build alignment and shared accountability across diverse teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Facilitate high priority and ambiguous conversations with experience to move teams from complexity to clarity.
* Partner with functional, brand, regional, business, and external partner leaders to ensure plans are integrated, commitments are realistic, and operational plans can be adopted and sustained.

**Projects you'll take ownership of:**

* A varied portfolio of strategic programs spanning key enterprise priorities. Program framing and mobilization, including charters, stakeholder maps, governance models, workstream structures, success measures, and responsibility matrices.
* Integrated program roadmaps and detailed plans, including milestones, dependencies, critical paths, resource assumptions, risk and issue logs, decision logs, and change control.
* Weekly, monthly, and quarterly program updates, executive briefings, steering committee materials, and decision papers tailored to different levels of the organization.
* Cross\-functional kickoffs, operating cadences, workstream reviews, leadership forums, and escalation mechanisms that maintain momentum and accountability.
* Launch and implementation readiness, including integrated readiness plans, testing and validation, contingency planning, stakeholder communications, and transition to business owners.
* Post\-launch stabilization and program closeout, including outcome measurement, lessons learned, benefit realization, knowledge transfer, and reusable playbooks.
* Adoption of AI\-enabled tools and modern program management methodologies to improve planning, synthesis, risk identification, decision support, and operational effectiveness.

### **What It Takes to Make the Stay**

**You have these minimum qualifications:**

* Seven (7\) years of professional experience in strategic program management, business operations, strategy, consulting, marketing, loyalty, or a related discipline.
* Four (4\) years of experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs from strategy through implementation in a large, global, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated expertise translating strategy into structured execution and measurable outcomes, with strong command of scope, schedule, governance, risk, issue, decision, and change management.
* Experience synthesizing complex information into concise updates, decision points, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Exceptional stakeholder leadership and influence across functions, brands, regions, partners, and organizational levels.
* Broad business and marketing acumen, with working knowledge of brand, loyalty and customer experience, partnerships, digital, media, analytics, technology, commercial functions, and regional activation.
* Travel up to 5%.

**It would be useful if you have:**

* Experience in hospitality, travel, consumer services, loyalty programs, new brand launches, or strategic partnerships.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing web or digital projects within a federal government contracting environment, including hands\-on familiarity with Drupal, federal .gov websites, and Section 508 accessibility compliance. Experience with Akamai or comparable content delivery network (CDN), website performance, or edge\-security technologies is preferred.



This is a remote position supporting a federal customer located in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Manage federal web content management, website development, modernization, and operations and maintenance (O\&M) projects.
* Lead projects supporting public\-facing .gov websites and Drupal\-based content management systems.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and performance measures.

* Ensure websites and digital content comply with Section 508 accessibility requirements and applicable WCAG standards.

* Serve as a primary interface with federal customer stakeholders, technical teams, contractor leadership, subcontractors, and vendors.
* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, executive briefings, risk reports, and required contractual deliverables.
* Support compliance with applicable federal cybersecurity, privacy, accessibility, and digital\-service requirements.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience managing IT, web, digital, or technology projects.
* Demonstrated experience working as a federal government contractor or direct employee of a U.S. federal agency.
* Demonstrated project management experience supporting public\-facing federal .gov websites.
* Experience managing projects involving Drupal or Drupal\-based content management systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Section 508 accessibility compliance and familiarity with WCAG standards.
* Experience managing web development, content management, website O\&M, or digital modernization projects.
* Experience coordinating technical, content, accessibility, QA, security, and operational teams.
* Experience managing project schedules, risks, deliverables, performance metrics, and customer expectations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with federal customers, technical teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to obtain and maintain required federal Public Trust or suitability requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Akamai technologies, including CDN, caching, traffic management, website acceleration, edge delivery, or web application security.
* Experience managing large\-scale or high\-traffic federal websites.
* Experience with AWS or other cloud\-hosted web environments.
* Experience with Drupal upgrades, migrations, or modernization initiatives.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps and CI/CD processes supporting web applications.
* PMP certification.
* Agile certification such as CSM, PMI\-ACP, or SAFe.

Estimated Salary Range: $140,000 – $160,000 per year



Actual compensation will be based on relevant experience, education, certifications, technical qualifications, contractual requirements, geographic considerations, and other business factors.



Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with employer contribution or match; paid time off; paid holidays; and professional development opportunities.

jobs.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager, Secure Connection Services (SCS), Tactical Edge Mission Engineering Group (TEMEG)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Shape the future of secure communications for the world's most critical missions. As a Principal Technical Program Manager for SCS TEMEG, you'll define the strategy and lead customers and cross\-functional teams to solve problems of high ambiguity and high impact.  

  

Secure Connections Services (SCS), Tactical Edge Mission Engineering Group (TEMEG) designs, develops, and delivers emerging edge capabilities to enable the use of AWS services.  

  

You own the strategic roadmap and drive cross\-organizational alignment on priorities and delivery. You leverage deep technical expertise and executive\-level stakeholder management to deliver solutions from concept through customer adoption. You bring proven experience architecting large\-scale distributed systems and apply that expertise to commercial and government customers. You are data\- and metric\-driven, and relentlessly focused on performance in resource\-constrained environments.  

  

* Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize satellite connectivity in the cloud
* Work for a recognized leader in supporting space customers with cloud computing
* Have direct impact on hundreds, possibly thousands, of users of the AWS secure connections ecosystem.

  

If you're driven to lead at the intersection of security innovation and mission\-critical impact, this is the role for you.  

  

If Arlington, VA (Arlington HQ2\):  

  

This role will sit in our new headquarters in Northern Virginia, where Amazon will invest $2\.5 billion dollars, occupy 4 million square feet of energy efficient office space, and create at least 25,000 new full\-time jobs. Our employees and the neighboring community will also benefit from the associated investments from the Commonwealth including infrastructure updates, public transportation improvements, and new access to Reagan National Airport.  

  

By working together on behalf of our customers, we are building the future one innovative product, service, and idea at a time. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.  

  

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

In this role you will:  

  

* Serve as the primary executive interface with customers, translating mission\-critical requirements into product roadmap priorities for engineering teams
* Drive cross\-organizational alignment across product, engineering, sales, and partner teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Work across the product, program, engineering, hardware, software, and infrastructure teams to manage requirements, scope, and delivery of worldwide AWS security features and services
* Assess risks, anticipate issues, overcome technical obstacles, and make difficult trade\-off decisions while managing cost and schedule to drive adoption goals and meet our customer commitments.

  

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be detail oriented, and have excellent problem\-solving abilities. You will represent program status to senior leadership. Your program management expertise and operational excellence will influence teams’ decisions and drive secure and scalable solutions. You should be passionate about delivering great customer experiences and changing the way customers leverage AWS services.  

  

Builders at Amazon work on real world problems on a global scale, own their systems end\-to\-end, and influence the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions customers around the world. Join a team of super smart, customer obsessed builders that think big and have fun.  

  

A day in the life  

In this role, you will own the planning and execution of a new service managing cross\-team and cross\-org development and delivery, participating in architecture decisions, design reviews, and represent our service to Senior and Executive leadership. You will work with software developers and networking engineers along with product managers and other oranizations to deliver new services and new features create the best in class solutions for our customers worldwide!  

  

Candidates must be comfortable with ambiguity and eager to embrace ownership and accountability.  

  

About the team  

About AWS
  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Why AWS?  

  

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge\-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

Diverse Experiences

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description:
**ARM Group LLC** is seeking a **Civil or Environmental Project Manager** with land development experience to join our fast\-growing Energy and Power practice. In this role, you will manage development projects for renewable energy installations, working at the intersection of sustainable energy and environmental compliance. The successful candidate will collaborate with our multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, geologists, CAD designers, and administrative staff to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet our clients’ energy goals.


As a Project Manager, you will oversee stormwater management design, erosion and sediment control planning, and related land development engineering for solar, wind, and other energy \& power projects. You will apply your technical expertise to complete engineering calculations, prepare detailed reports, and develop design drawings using CAD Software. This role requires strong communication skills, as you will regularly interface with regulatory agencies, clients, and internal project teams to ensure project success.

**Location:** This position can be filled in our Columbia, MD or Ashland, VA office.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Manage and coordinate the development, design and permitting of multiple projects simultaneously for various projects throughout the Mid\-Atlantic region (ARM territory) with a primary focus in Maryland.
* Prepare and review engineering designs and permit applications in order to acquire approvals.
* Maintain complex schedules, develop project timelines, coordinate with subcontractors, and manage people and materials, acting as the direct point of contact for all stakeholders, in order to complete jobs on schedule and within budget guidelines.
* Monitor project work progress, adhering to the scope of work, and communicating with key stakeholders.
* Assess and mitigate project risks; Pro\-actively recognize problems and develop effective solutions.
* Perform quality assurance and quality control evaluations and/or check technical calculations and prepare project specifications.
* Prepare detailed models and technical documents to present project design/feasibility findings to stakeholders.
* Evaluate the economic, engineering, or pragmatic feasibility of projects based on site and/or building constraints (i.e., constructability assessment).


Requirements:
* Professional Engineer (P.E.) License in Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, or other mid\-Atlantic state(s).
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in engineering (Civil or Environmental) from an accredited four\-year college or university.
* 5\+ years of experience designing and permitting projects involving land development or land use permitting.
* Experience with stormwater management plans, erosion \& sediment control planning and permitting (NPDES).
* Knowledge of State environmental regulations and experience navigating local permitting authorities for zoning, subdivision, and stormwater ordinances.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with proven ability to manage multiple, complex projects.
* Creative and detail\-oriented team player with a strong work ethic, self\-motivated mindset, and eagerness to grow.
* Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing with key stakeholders, including officials and environmental regulators, to exchange information, clearly explain the project goals, obtain permit approvals, coordinate compliance efforts.
* Articulate, confident and able to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and the general public.
* Experience managing vendor and client payment terms to achieve positive cash flow by reviewing project billings, accounts receivable, monitoring work in progress preparing client invoices and assisting with payment collection.
* Reasonably proficient in AutoCAD, Hydrocad (or alternate stormwater modeling software), MS Office Suite, and MS Project or equivalent project scheduling software.

**Your Wellness, Our Priority: A Look at Our Benefits**


We invest in our team's well\-being and future through a comprehensive benefits package with a range of offerings designed to support you holistically. Our health and wellness offerings include two Health Insurance options (Traditional PPO and QHDHP with an HSA), vision and dental coverage, life insurance, disability protection, accident and critical illness coverage. To enhance your future financial security, we provide a 401(k) with company match, HSA/FSA accounts, and 529 college savings plans. Work\-life balance is prioritized through our generous PTO starting at 15 days per year and 10 paid holidays per year, giving you ample time to rest, recharge, and attend to life outside the office. An Employee Assistance Program is provided to you and your household with resources to assist you in managing a variety of situations. We invest in your professional growth through our Tuition Reimbursement program and continuing education opportunities. After 6 months of employment, all team members become eligible for quarterly bonuses, providing additional avenues for financial growth. This robust package is designed to foster a workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally, underscoring our dedication to your overall well\-being and future success.

**Compensation Description:**


Project Manager: $92,200\-123,000/year, based on experience
